steps.instruction: With a rinsed filter and the grounds ready, start the timer and add 45 g of water to wet the coffee.
Add 105 g slowly in circles, bringing the scale to 150 g.
Add the remaining 100 g, bringing the scale to 250 g.
Let the water drain through. Aim to finish around 3 minutes.
Use a dripper large enough for two cups. With the filter rinsed and grounds ready, start the timer and add 90 g of water.
Add 210 g slowly, bringing the scale to 300 g. Pause briefly if the dripper is nearly full.
Add the remaining 200 g, bringing the scale to 500 g.
Let the water drain through. Aim to finish around 4 minutes.
Place the AeroPress upright on a sturdy mug with the filter cap attached and coffee inside. Start the timer and add 200 g of water.
Stir gently to wet all the grounds, then insert the plunger slightly to limit dripping.
Leave the coffee to steep until the timer reaches 2 minutes.
Press gently for about 30 seconds, stopping if you feel strong resistance.
